Markets.title: Rays of Belief IPO: Mom's Belief operator announces price band for issue opening on September 1
Markets.summary: Rays of Belief, operator of the Mom's Belief brand, has set a price band of Rs 227 to 239 per share for its Rs 125 crore IPO opening on September 1. The company will use the proceeds from the 52.30 lakh fresh shares to expand its network of centers across India.

Markets.title: Multibagger stocks: Ather Energy, Hind Copper, MCX among stocks which surged up to 250% in one year
Markets.summary: Despite overall market losses on the Nifty 50, several Nifty 500 stocks delivered multibagger returns of up to 250% over the past year. Ather Energy led these gains with a 248% surge, followed by companies like Hindustan Copper, HFCL, and Welspun Corp.

Markets.title: Oil fall lifts rupee to over one-week high after central bank keeps lid on losses
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee rose to a one-week high on Tuesday due to a more than three percent drop in Brent crude prices and intervention by the central bank. During the same trading session, Asian currencies declined slightly while the dollar index fell below 99.

Markets.title: Global Market: Japanese businesses turn to currency hedging as weak Yen drives up import costs
Markets.summary: Japanese companies are increasingly using currency hedging and long-term supplier agreements to manage rising import costs caused by the weak yen. Both importers and exporters are locking in prices and exchange rates to protect themselves against ongoing currency volatility and unpredictable expenses.

Markets.title: Sensex rises 287 points, Nifty closes above 24,300 as market swings into green on first monthly expiry after CAS
Markets.summary: The Indian stock market ended higher on Tuesday after a volatile session, with the Sensex gaining 287 points and the Nifty closing above 24,300. Pharma, PSU bank, and consumer durable sectors led the gains, while private banks and metals declined.

Markets.title: MFs kept buying these 9 largecap stocks for 2 quarters; shares surged up to 50%
Markets.summary: Mutual funds steadily increased their holdings in nine large-cap stocks over the past two quarters. These specific stocks, led by Adani Energy Solutions, Lenskart Solutions, and ABB India, generated gains of 25% to 50% so far in CY26.

Geo-Political.title: China warns it will safeguard its interests after US widens sanctions against Iran
Geo-Political.summary: The United States expanded sanctions against Iran and threatened to isolate nations continuing to do business with Tehran. In response, China warned that it will safeguard its own interests since it purchases a large portion of Iranian oil.

Geo-Political.title: Lockerbie bombing trial postponed days before it was due to start
Geo-Political.summary: The trial of a Libyan man for the Lockerbie bombing has been delayed for a third time. This postponement occurs just days before the scheduled start due to new evidence emerging in the 37-year-old case.

Geo-Political.title: US removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism
Geo-Political.summary: The Trump administration has removed Syria from the US list of state sponsors of terrorism. This decision follows the administration's embrace of Syria's new president, former al-Qaeda-linked militant Ahmed al-Sharaa.

Geo-Political.title: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
Geo-Political.summary: A tornado struck the south-western French village of Pomas, damaging hundreds of homes. Fifteen people were hospitalized with injuries following the severe weather.

Geo-Political.title: Kit Harington replaces Nicholas Hoult in HBO's Harry Potter series
Geo-Political.summary: Kit Harington has replaced Nicholas Hoult as Gilderoy Lockhart in HBO's upcoming Harry Potter series. Hoult withdrew from the role due to scheduling conflicts just two weeks after his casting was announced.

Geo-Political.title: US-Canada trade war escalates as Trump threatens tariff hike on vehicles
Geo-Political.summary: Canadian official Mark Carney accused U.S. President Donald Trump of trying to destroy Canada's auto industry amid an escalating trade war. Carney stated that trade talks will not resume unless the United States adopts a more cooperative attitude.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course on the subject. The author achieved this visibility without paying for advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that drive industry innovation and efficiency. These advanced applications automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase overall productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence content generators help users create engaging and relevant material efficiently. Because many different tools are available on the market, choosing the right one can be challenging.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money through its platform. The article also provides examples of top CJ affiliate programs and lists alternative networks.

Data & Insights.title: EMT: India secures top rank again in July among EM peers as stock market posts gains
Data & Insights.summary: India ranked first on Mint's Emerging Markets Tracker for July for the third consecutive month. This achievement was driven by resilient economic performance and strong stock market inflows despite rising inflation.

Data & Insights.title: India leads South Asia’s growth, but China+1 gains remain uncertain: World Bank economist
Data & Insights.summary: India continues to drive economic growth in South Asia, according to World Bank economist Franziska Ohnsorge. However, India has not yet fully capitalized on the China+1 manufacturing shift, while artificial intelligence presents a larger potential growth opportunity.

Data & Insights.title: Scott Bessent eying US Treasury cashpile, could use $1 trillion General Account for debt buybacks, says report
Data & Insights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent plans to use the department's $1 trillion General Account to fund expanded buybacks of older, higher-yielding securities. This strategy, reported by CNBC citing senior officials, aims to manage the national debt more effectively.

Data & Insights.title: India negotiating trade deals with nations, blocs worth $15 trillion GDP: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is negotiating trade agreements with countries and blocs representing a combined GDP of $15 trillion. During a visit to Japan, Goyal is leading a business delegation of over 200 representatives to strengthen bilateral trade and investment.

Data & Insights.title: Iranian rial hits record low of 2.02 million against US dollar amid threat of new Trump sanctions — Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: On August 24, the Iranian rial fell 4.5% to a record low of 2.02 million against the US dollar. This currency drop occurred after US President Donald Trump announced plans for severe new economic sanctions against Tehran.

Data & Insights.title: Service producer prices index mixed in Q1; air passenger services surge 32%
Data & Insights.summary: First-quarter service producer prices showed mixed results with 2022-23 as the base year, while air passenger services surged by 32%. The government noted that aggregate weights were not assigned because the seven tracked services do not cover the entire sector.

India.title: J&K Power Hike Triggers Opposition Protest, Omar Abdullah Defends Move
India.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir government increased electricity tariffs, prompting protests from opposition parties. Chief Minister Omar Abdullah defended the price hike as a necessary measure driven by inflation and rising power costs.

India.title: Rajnath Singh Clears Transfer Of DRDO Missile Technologies To Indian Firms
India.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has approved the transfer of DRDO missile technologies to domestic companies. This initiative aims to boost India's defence self-reliance and increase the involvement of local industries in the defence sector.

India.title: From Gold Medals To Ground Reality: Life Of UPSC Aspirants In Mukherjee Nagar
India.summary: Students preparing for the UPSC civil services exam in Delhi's Mukherjee Nagar face high financial costs and immense pressure to succeed. This intense preparation environment exposes the difficult ground realities that aspirants experience behind the pursuit of elite government jobs.

India.title: Mistaken For Tamil Nadu Minister Keerthana Over Short Dress, Malaysia-Based Woman Speaks Out
India.summary: A Malaysia-based woman was mistakenly targeted by online trolls who confused her with Tamil Nadu minister Keerthana because of a short dress she wore. She spoke out against the scrutiny, urging people to stop judging women by their clothing and to act more responsibly online.

India.title: UPSC Invites Applications For 80 Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner Posts, Check Details
India.summary: The Union Public Service Commission has invited applications for 80 Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner positions. These vacancies are within the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation under the Ministry of Labour and Employment.

India.title: Rain In East, Dry Spell In West, South: How Monsoon Will Shape This Week
India.summary: Heavy rain will continue in East Madhya Pradesh until August 29. After August 29, the weather will change into scattered and isolated rainfall events.

General.title: China warns it will safeguard its interests after US widens sanctions against Iran
General.summary: China warned it will protect its interests after the United States expanded economic sanctions against Iran. The U.S. previously threatened to isolate any nations continuing to trade with Tehran, which is a major supplier of oil to Beijing.

General.title: Man dies in crash after police pursuit
General.summary: A man died in a car crash following a police pursuit. A woman sustained serious injuries in the same collision and remains hospitalized in critical condition.

General.title: Yellow weather warnings issued as thunderstorms and flooding forecast
General.summary: The Met Office has issued a yellow weather warning for heavy showers and thunderstorms across the UK on Wednesday. These severe conditions are forecast to move northwards and could cause flooding.

General.title: Young care leavers dying early a 'national tragedy'
General.summary: A new review reveals that young care leavers have a death rate about four times higher than the general population. Experts describe this situation as a "national tragedy."

General.title: Moment tornado tears through southern France
General.summary: A tornado struck villages in southern France, injuring more than 40 people. The extreme weather also destroyed multiple homes in the area.

General.title: Boy, 3, injured in crocodile attack returns home
General.summary: A three-year-old boy has returned home after undergoing seven surgeries following a crocodile attack. His family stated that he is happy to be back.
